texts.title: Working from home: a manager’s view

paragraphs.text: Since our office allowed staff to work from home two days a week, I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work. Some managers worry that people at home are less productive, but I have found no evidence of that in my team. The real cost is harder to measure: new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them.

items.prompt: The writer has noticed that the quality of work has fallen since staff began working from home.
The writer believes new employees should work in the office every day.
